name: OSB Group Plc
summary: OSB Group Plc, through its subsidiaries, operates as a specialist mortgage lending company in the United Kingdom and India. The company operates in two segments, OneSavings Bank (OSB) and Charter Court Financial Services (CCFS). It offers buy-to-let, residential, bridging, and commercial and semi-commercial mortgages; and residential development and asset finance services. The company also provides mortgage servicing, lending, deposit taking, originating, and administration and analytical services; land lease investment; and back-office processing services.
